sources: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234118 and /rates; public campsite search for 234118 (26 sites, per-site length/coordinates)
Esri World_Imagery with the recreation.gov site points

values.note: 19 RV/tent sites and 7 tent-only; every RV site is a back-in. Nine take a 23-ft rig (sites 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 11, 15, 19, 25 at 25-32 ft); the rest are 20-22 ft. Dirt parking aprons.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234118 ('Geneva park has 26 campsites to accommodate both RV and tent camping ... Parking aprons are dirt') + recreation.gov campsite catalog (per-site Max Vehicle Length 10-32 ft, all Back-In), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/geneva-park-campground ('No dump station or hook-up is available'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: The water system has been shut since June 2020 pending repairs - bring all your water.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/geneva-park-campground ('As of June 15, 2020, the water system at this campground is closed until further notice'; 'No dump station or hook-up is available') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234118 ('Vault toilets, picnic tables and grills are provided'; notice 'No water Available'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend (2026: May 22 - September 6 on recreation.gov).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/geneva-park-campground ('Seasons of Use | Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234118/rates (2026 Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-06), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Book at least 4 days ahead on recreation.gov or 877-444-6777; 16 sites are reservable, 10 first-come. Two nights Friday-Saturday and three on holiday weekends; walk-ups are exempt from the minimums.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/geneva-park-campground ('Call 877-444-6777 or visit Recreation.gov at least four days in advance. A minimum stay on Friday and Saturday night is required on weekends. A three-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. Walk-ups are exempt from the nightly minimum') + recreation.gov rules (minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14, reservationCutOff 4) and catalog (16 reservable, 10 first-come), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $27 a site (two vehicles or one RV); $11 a third vehicle; day use $11. Senior/Access passes halve the site fee.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/geneva-park-campground ('$27 fee per site for overnight camping ... $11 fee for a third vehicle') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234118/rates (2026 Peak Season STANDARD NONELECTRIC $27), read 2026-10-28

note: Pike-San Isabel NF campground at 9,815 ft on the south side of the Guanella Pass Scenic Byway, off Park CR 62 from Grant via FR 119. Expect potholes and washboard on the approach; the campground's interior road is rough. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: confirmed 26 sites, max 32 ft, reservable on recreation.gov, $27. Added: all back-in (pull_through false), 9 sites fit 23 ft, no hookups/dump, vault toilets, NO potable water (system shut since 2020), season Memorial Day - Labor Day (2026 May 22 - Sept 6), some first-come sites, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums (walk-ups exempt), 14-night max, 4-day booking cutoff. Pin ~280 m from the site centroid. Note trimmed.
flags: Minimum stays: recreation.gov rules minWeekendStay 2 and minHolidayWeekendStay 3; the FS page says 'Walk-ups are exempt from the nightly minimum' (so a same-day walk-up can stay one night).
Missing phone: South Platte Ranger District 303-275-5610 (FS page; also recreation.gov facility phone). Concessionaire line (303) 647-2366.
Website is recreation.gov only; the FS page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/geneva-park-campground could be added.

Pin 39.5302,-105.7335 sits in the trees ~130 m east of site 1 and ~280 m from the site centroid 39.53089,-105.73662 (the loop lies to its west). Under the 500 m threshold; a pin near 39.5308,-105.7360 would sit on the loop.

Road: recreation.gov notice 'Expect rough road conditions and erosion problems such as potholes and wash-boarding'; no 4WD/high-clearance wording for the campground itself (the FS mentions nearby four-wheel-drive roads as an activity).
Waterfront (stored not waterfront) stands: Geneva Creek runs ~250-300 m east beyond the byway; the loop is in forest.
